snippet.title: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

Play on Steam Now!
